description: Local news search results about February salary and textile issues describe negotiations/petitions or stakeholder meetings, not a documented public assembly with a simultaneous crowd estimate. No in-month source established an actual >=50 public gathering making a demand on the Lesotho state.
required_followup: Further distinct contemporaneous local reporting would be needed before coding an event; union membership, talks, petitions, or a threatened strike are not a public crowd.

description: Twelve captured response records representing 13 search strings cover English/Sesotho, half-month windows, public employees, textiles, students, teachers, nurses, transport/farm issues, Maseru and named districts. Results remain noisy and no systematic archive or LexisNexis search was available. One LENA result was explicitly dated February 2024 and its body fetch timed out.
required_followup: Retain open coverage for district and sector sources, the absent LexisNexis archive, and any event occurring beyond the returned web-index results.
